description: Figure 7 is a horizontal stacked bar chart that illustrates the average rate at which a model attends to different input segments during generation. The categories are listed on the vertical axis, labeled with "Ours" and "Standard", and are presented in a fixed order. The value axis is on the horizontal axis, labeled as a percentage, with a linear scale ranging from 0% to approximately 70%, and tick labels at intervals of 10%. Each bar is divided into three segments, colored blue, orange, and green, representing "Context", "Generated Response", and "Other", respectively. For "Ours", the bar is approximately 60.6% blue, 31.7% orange, and 7% green, while for "Standard", it is around 23.6% blue, 51.1% orange, and 25.3% green. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
